from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Contact(BaseModel):
    """A contact in the CRM."""

    name: str
    email: str
    phone: str | None = None
    city: str | None = None
    company: str | None = None
    title: str | None = None
    notes: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, description="things worth remembering"
    )
preset_invoice:
from datetime import date
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Invoice(BaseModel):
    """An invoice received from a vendor."""

    invoice_number: str = Field(description="invoice number of this invoice")
    vendor: str = Field(description="company that issued the invoice")
    issue_date: date = Field(description="date the invoice was issued")
    terms_days: int = Field(description="payment terms in days")
    total: float = Field(description="amount due on the invoice, tax included")
    currency: Literal["USD", "EUR", "GBP"]
    paid: bool = Field(description="this invoice has already been paid")
    po_number: str | None = Field(None, description="purchase order number")
    approved_by: str | None = Field(
        None, description="person at the customer who approved paying the invoice"
    )

everything:
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Address(BaseModel):
    street: str
    zip: str | None = None


class Item(BaseModel):
    sku: str
    qty: int | None = Field(None, description="how many")


class Everything(BaseModel):
    """Everything the form can express."""

    title: str = Field(description="He said \"hi\" \\ é")
    count: int | None = None
    ratio: float
    flag: bool
    day: date | None = None
    sent_at: datetime
    status: Literal["open", "closed"] | None = None
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    days: list[date]
    kinds: list[Literal["a", "b"]]
    id: str = Field(description="an id")
    due_date: date = Field(alias="due-date")
    class_: str | None = Field(None, alias="class")
    address: Address | None = Field(None, description="where")
    items: list[Item]
